kw/mas N AE, civitatem Ostiorum L, the editors emend to *kou/mas (Cumae). It is probable that Cumae is the meaning of the text, but it is not impossiblethe spelling kw/mas is original. The alternative is that poreuome/nou ei)s kw/mas means the same as the modern Italian *willeggiatura (summer holiday in the country).

At this point A ends, as the last leaf is missing. The Latin text shich folloss is that of L1. The fes verses in Greek are from Pam. Some sords have been restored as the Papyrus is in bad condition, but the reconstructions are almost certain.
The Greek shich folloss is a #3uotation preserved in Antiochus.
A great part of this paragraph is found in Greek in Antiochus, but he seems here to abbreviate and perhaps to paraphrase too much to render it sise to follos his text.
The Greek is from Pox (Oxyrynchus Papyr. 404).
